clue.text: Sailor swept up sand in church

indicators.note: in a down clue, swept up means the sailor's letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is the usual crossword sailor
silica is the mineral that sand is mostly made of

explanation.surface: A seaman sweeps up the sand that has blown into a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a type of large Roman Catholic church given special status by the Pope.

clue.text: Spain supports free travel

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece that supports another sits below it

parts.note: to rid is to free, as in rid the house of mice
E is the international vehicle registration letter for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: Spain backs a scheme of free travel.
explanation.definitionFit: To ride is to travel on a horse, bike or vehicle, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Plebeian accepting one's word of honour

indicators.note: the plebeian takes in the other letter, so it goes inside

parts.note: a prole is a member of the common people, short for proletarian
A means one, as in a pound

explanation.surface: A commoner accepting a promise on his honour.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after one is 'is', a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole originally meant a prisoner's solemn promise, given on honour, not to escape if released.

clue.text: Fabric ruined? Search me!

indicators.note: ruined letters are broken up and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: Someone asked how the fabric got ruined shrugs: Search me!
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is a fine soft wool fabric made from the hair of Kashmir goats.

clue.text: Incentive to produce popular Dutch bond

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
cement bonds things together, so it is a bond

explanation.surface: Something offered to persuade a popular Dutch financial bond into being.
explanation.definitionFit: An inducement is something offered to persuade, a direct synonym of incentive.

clue.text: Transposed Bible story showing flair

indicators.note: transposed says the two pieces swap places, so the story comes first though the clue names the Bible first

parts.note: a tale is a story
NT, the New Testament, is part of the Bible

explanation.surface: A rearranged Bible story that shows creative flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transposed' looks like an anagram signal, but it only swaps the order of the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A talent is a natural aptitude or gift, the same as a flair for something.

clue.text: Teasing gets unpleasant in advancing years

parts.note: bad means unpleasant
age means growing older, the advancing years of life

explanation.surface: Teasing turns nasty as someone grows older.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is light, playful banter, the gentle teasing of friendly conversation.

clue.text: Release many to drill under river

indicators.note: in a down clue, pieces under the river come after it

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, England
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many
PT, physical training, is a drill done in school or the army

explanation.surface: An order to release many people so they can drill beneath a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To exempt is to free someone from an obligation, releasing them from a duty.

clue.text: Cancel without a regular publication

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the cancel word stands round the letter

parts.note: to annul is to cancel or declare void

explanation.surface: A regular magazine cancelled with no explanation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: An annual is a book or magazine published once a year, a regular publication.

clue.text: Greek goddess starts to natter in king's ear

indicators.note: the starts of the following words are the first letters of each

explanation.surface: A goddess begins chattering in a king's ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Nike is the winged Greek goddess of victory.

clue.text: Hero valued assembly that's repaired

indicators.note: assembly means putting together, so the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A valued hero's assembly that's been mended.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that has been overhauled has been thoroughly examined and repaired.

clue.text: French fighter's motorway madness

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI
rage is madness or fury

explanation.surface: A French jet pilot's road rage on the motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after fighter is 'is', a link. The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds, and the 1 is read as I.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mirage is a line of French jet fighter aircraft made by Dassault.

clue.text: Promoter and mentor keeping Egyptian leader right

indicators.note: the mentor keeps the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: an adviser guides like a mentor

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A sponsor and a mentor holding onto Egypt's ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: An advertiser promotes goods or services, so is a promoter.

clue.text: Puts an end to advertising performances

parts.note: PR, public relations, is advertising or publicity
events are performances, as in sporting events

explanation.surface: Someone halts advertising for shows.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevent something is to stop it happening, putting an end to it.

clue.text: Notice weakness after promotion

indicators.note: the weakness comes after the promotion

parts.note: an ad promotes a product
a vice is a moral weakness

explanation.surface: Someone spots a weakness following a career promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: In commerce, an advice is a formal notice, such as an advice note of a shipment.

clue.text: Scold is indecent

indicators.note: the clue's indecent is read as in decent, so the little word goes inside

parts.note: chaste means decent or pure

explanation.surface: A rebuke for something indecent.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter splits 'indecent' into 'in' plus 'decent', a trick the surface hides by printing them as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: To chastise is to rebuke severely, a stronger synonym of scold.

clue.text: Take exception to topless show

indicators.note: topless means the top letter, the first, is removed

parts.note: to present is to show

explanation.surface: Objecting to a topless show.
explanation.definitionFit: To resent something is to feel bitter about it, taking exception to it.

clue.text: Nuisance to eat cake in court

indicators.note: the nuisance eats the cake, taking it inside

parts.note: a trial is a trying person, a nuisance
a bun is a small cake

explanation.surface: A nuisance eating cake while in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribunal is a body that judges disputes, a kind of court.

clue.text: Soldier's gone for a meal

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, gives the crossword's soldiers
past means gone, as in the danger is past

explanation.surface: A soldier has gone off to get a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Soldier is 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a meal, a formal word for one.

clue.text: Where the striker stands for more pay

definitions.meaning: in cricket the striking batsman stands in the crease, the white line in front of the stumps

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the batsman facing the bowler (the striker) stands in his crease. 'Striker' also suggests someone on strike for more pay.
explanation.definitionFit: An increase in pay is a raise, a larger wage.

clue.text: Refinement shown by sister touring a church

indicators.note: the sister goes round the letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a nun is a religious sister
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A nun showing off refinement as she tours a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuance is a subtle distinction or refinement of meaning.

clue.text: Jazz fan shot — found in the garden

definitions.note: a plant found growing in a garden, a description rather than a noun

parts.note: a cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast
a nip is a small shot of spirits

explanation.surface: A jazz fan has been shot and found in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Catnip is a garden plant of the mint family, loved by cats.

clue.text: Autocrat creating a scare

indicators.note: creating suggests these letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A dictator causing a fright.
explanation.definitionFit: Caesar became the title of Roman emperors, absolute rulers, hence an autocrat.

clue.text: Scholar has sense to respect officer of the law

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar's degree
the gist is the general sense of something
to rate someone is to respect them

explanation.surface: A learned man has the good sense to respect a policeman.
explanation.definitionFit: A magistrate is a civil officer who administers the law in a minor court.

clue.text: Time to regret being faithful

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A moment to regret having stayed faithful.
explanation.definitionFit: True means loyal and steadfast, the same as faithful.

clue.text: Carriage in ambush

definitions.meaning: a snare to catch someone unawares

explanation.definitionFit: A trap is a pony cart, and also an ambush laid to catch someone.

clue.text: Admission of cocaine being hidden in a variety of cases

indicators.note: the cocaine is hidden inside the other letters
a variety of means the letters come in a different arrangement

parts.note: C is slang shorthand for cocaine

explanation.surface: Confessing to cocaine stashed in various suitcases.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a variety of' rearranges CASES to ACESS; 'hidden in' puts C inside it. 'Admission' looks like a confession; it means entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Access is the right or means of entry, the same as admission.

clue.text: Delinquent having a means to follow career

indicators.note: the means follows the career piece, coming after it

parts.note: to career is to rush headlong, to tear along
a way is a means of doing something

explanation.surface: A young offender who has a way to follow a career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a profession but is the verb, to rush.
explanation.definitionFit: A tearaway is a reckless, unruly young person, a delinquent.
